tool-doctor.title: Tool configuration check
tool-doctor.loading: Checking authorization, node identity and inventory for this configuration…
tool-doctor.expired: This observation has expired. Check again before taking the next step.
tool-doctor.changed: The configuration has changed. Refresh the original details for current-version guidance.
tool-doctor.read_failed: The current check could not be read. Check again.
tool-doctor.suspended: Waiting for the original operation or detail read before checking this configuration.
tool-doctor.invalid_response: The tool-check response could not be verified. Read it again.
tool-doctor.prerequisites_checked: Known prerequisites were checked in this observation.
tool-doctor.available: The original configuration was dispatchable at this read.
tool-doctor.unavailable: The original configuration was not dispatchable at this read.
tool-doctor.boundary: A valid node identity does not mean it is online. Probing, model sign-in, budget and task execution are checked separately.
tool-doctor.shared_readonly: Open the shared node through this project's read-only access.
tool-doctor.inspect_hint: Request a new check from this exact node, wait for its report, then review the configuration.
tool-doctor.maintenance.title: Suggested next step
tool-doctor.maintenance.reason.inspectio: An inspection is already waiting for the current node to claim it. View the original request rather than submitting another.
The current node claimed the inspection, but no complete result has arrived. View the original inspection's progress.
The original inspection outcome needs reconciliation. Follow that record before requesting a new inspection.
tool-doctor.maintenance.reason.recovery_: Reconciliation authorization was saved. The exact node still needs to submit the original stop proof.
The original stop proof was saved, but durable node acknowledgement is still pending. The original maintenance reservation has not been released.
The original reconciliation authorization expired. Follow the original unknown inspection and explicitly decide how to reconcile it.
tool-doctor.maintenance.reason.maintenan: This read confirms that the node supports controlled maintenance. Review and explicitly request one inspection; this does not repair or enable the tool automatically.
The maintenance capability observation expired. Open the exact node and recheck it before requesting a new inspection.
The node's declared maintenance protocol is not supported. Review its configuration; this declaration cannot authorize an inspection.
No verifiable maintenance capability declaration is available. Review the exact node and configuration; a registered identity does not establish maintenance support.
tool-doctor.maintenance.reason.profile_r: The original profile was permanently revoked and cannot start new maintenance inspections. Historical inspections and reconciliation records remain.
tool-doctor.maintenance.reason.worker_un: The current node identity or project grant is unavailable. Open the matching node; old identities and operations are not restored or restarted automatically.
